name: Neon Afterimage
description:
A backdoored CI runner is still humming in a neon corporate datacenter. Reconstruct what happened and recover the evidence the intruder left behind. The host runs on the lab network; scan 172.20.0.0/24, where challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199. The challenge access details provide the shell login.
